ai_bubble.definition: A period in which investment and valuations in AI exceed the technology's near-term economic value.

pay_review.definition: A regular discussion of your pay, often once a year, separate from a performance review.
pay_review.example: My pay review is at the end of March, so I asked to be included.

ripe.definition: Ready to eat, sweet and soft. A green mango is not ripe yet.
ripe.example: This banana is yellow and ripe.
